name: GL_PACS_COMBINATIONS_
description: This table contains the partial account combinations that are associated with a partial account combination set.

columns.name: PACS_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Partial account combination unique identifier.

columns.name: PACS_DEFINITION_ID
columns.description: Partial account combination set that contains this partial account combination.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE1
columns.description: The value of the first segment in the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE2
columns.description: The value of the second segment in the partial account combination set.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE3
columns.description: The value of the third segment in the partial account combination set, if there is a third segment. If the partial account combination set does not have a third segment, then a single space is stored.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE4
columns.description: The value of the fourth segment in the partial account combination set, if there is a fourth segment. If the partial account combination set does not have a fourth segment, then a single space is stored.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE5
columns.description: The value of the fifth segment in the partial account combination set, if there is a fifth segment. If the partial account combination set does not have a fifth segment, then a single space is stored.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Earliest date on which this partial account combination is valid.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Latest date on which this partial account combination is valid.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
